level.title: Level 3: Extended Elementary & Conversational Fluency
level.description: Transisi menuju kemandirian berbahasa: kuasai bentuk continuous, rencana masa depan (will vs going to), perbandingan benda dan tempat, serta percakapan sosial nyata.

modules.title: Present Continuous: Actions Happening Now
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan rumus To Be (Am/Is/Are) + Verb-ing untuk menyatakan aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat berbicara tanpa menghilangkan to be.

content.concept: Subject + am/is/are + Verb-ing (Contoh: I am studying, She is cooking, They are waiting).
rules: Subject + am/is/are + Verb-ing (Contoh: I am studying, She is cooking, They are waiting).
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya makan' menjadi 'I eating' tanpa To Be ('am'). Ingat: V-ing WAJIB didahului to be (am/is/are).
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering langsung menerjemahkan 'Saya makan' menjadi 'I eating' tanpa To Be ('am'). Ingat: V-ing WAJIB didahului to be (am/is/are).

items.example: He is cooking dinner in the kitchen right now.
They are studying for tomorrow's English test.
I am waiting for the bus at the stop.
She is running in the park this morning.
Who is calling you on the phone?
We are listening to the teacher carefully.
Look outside, it is raining heavily.
My father is working from home today.

content.context: Rina menelepon Kevin yang sedang sibuk di rumahnya.

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Hi Kevin, can you talk right now?
dialogue.translation: Hai Kevin, bisakah kamu bicara sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.text: Sorry Rina, I am cooking dinner at the moment. Can I call you back?
dialogue.translation: Maaf Rina, aku sedang memasak makan malam saat ini. Bisakah aku meneleponmu balik?

dialogue.speaker: Rina
dialogue.text: Sure! What are you making?
dialogue.translation: Tentu! Apa yang sedang kamu buat?

dialogue.speaker: Kevin
dialogue.text: I am preparing fried rice. I will call you in twenty minutes.
dialogue.translation: Aku sedang menyiapkan nasi goreng. Aku akan menghubungimu dalam 20 menit.

drills.prompt: I am working on my computer right now.
drills.targetText: I am working on my computer right now.
drills.translation: Saya sedang bekerja di komputer saya sekarang.

drills.prompt: She is listening to music in her room.
drills.targetText: She is listening to music in her room.
drills.translation: Dia sedang mendengarkan musik di kamarnya.

drills.prompt: What are you doing at the moment?
drills.targetText: What are you doing at the moment?
drills.translation: Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan saat ini?

roleplay.context: Kamu sedang di kafe dan temanmu bertanya apa kegiatanmu saat ini.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Are you busy? What are you doing right now?
turns.translation: Halo! Apakah kamu sibuk? Apa yang sedang kamu lakukan sekarang?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I am having coffee and studying my English notes.
turns.translation: Saya sedang minum kopi dan mempelajari catatan bahasa Inggris saya.

challenge.scenario: Jelaskan apa yang sedang kamu dan orang-orang di sekitarmu lakukan sekarang dalam 2 kalimat bahasa Inggris.
challenge.example: I am practicing English speaking now. Outside, the rain is falling quietly.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang benar secara tata bahasa:
questions.explanation: Present continuous membutuhkan To Be 'am' sebelum verb-ing.

questions.question: Look! The children ______ football in the yard.
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'the children' menggunakan to be 'are' + verb-ing.

questions.question: Bentuk negatif dari 'She is cooking':
questions.explanation: Negasi continuous dibentuk dengan menambahkan 'not' setelah to be: 'is not cooking'.

questions.question: Susun pertanyaan yang tepat:
questions.explanation: Rumus kalimat tanya WH: WH + to be + Subject + V-ing.

questions.question: Apa arti dari 'It is raining outside'?
questions.explanation: 'Is raining' menyatakan kejadian yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.

modules.title: Present Simple vs Present Continuous: Habits vs Temporary Actions
modules.objective: Mampu membedakan dengan tepat kapan menggunakan Present Simple (fakta/rutinitas) dan Present Continuous (kejadian sementara saat ini).

content.concept: Present Simple untuk rutinitas (Contoh: 'I work at a bank'). Present Continuous untuk aksi saat ini atau sementara (Contoh: 'Today, I am working from home').
rules: Present Simple untuk rutinitas (Contoh: 'I work at a bank'). Present Continuous untuk aksi saat ini atau sementara (Contoh: 'Today, I am working from home').
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kata 'sedang' dan rutinitas sering memakai kata kerja sama ('Saya kerja di bank' vs 'Saya lagi kerja'). Di bahasa Inggris, bentuk tenses wajib dibedakan.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kata 'sedang' dan rutinitas sering memakai kata kerja sama ('Saya kerja di bank' vs 'Saya lagi kerja'). Di bahasa Inggris, bentuk tenses wajib dibedakan.

items.example: I usually drink tea, but today I am having coffee.
He is currently living with his brother.
Reading books before sleeping is a healthy habit.
This project is only temporary for three months.
She has a permanent job in Jakarta.
Nowadays, many people are working remotely.
Practice is essential in everyday life.
She cannot answer because she is driving at the moment.

content.context: Sarah dan Doni bertemu saat makan siang di kantor.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Doni, do you usually drive to work?
dialogue.translation: Doni, apakah kamu biasanya menyetir ke tempat kerja?

dialogue.speaker: Doni
dialogue.text: Yes, I usually drive. But this week my car is broken, so I am taking the train.
dialogue.translation: Ya, biasanya aku menyetir. Tapi minggu ini mobilku rusak, jadi aku sedang naik kereta.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: I see. How is the train ride?
dialogue.translation: Begitu ya. Bagaimana perjalanan keretanya?

dialogue.speaker: Doni
dialogue.text: It is crowded, but I am reading a great book during the trip.
dialogue.translation: Padat, tapi aku sedang membaca buku bagus selama perjalanan.

drills.prompt: I live in Bandung, but this month I am staying in Jakarta.
drills.targetText: I live in Bandung, but this month I am staying in Jakarta.
drills.translation: Saya tinggal di Bandung, tapi bulan ini saya sedang tinggal di Jakarta.

drills.prompt: He drinks coffee every morning, but right now he is drinking milk.
drills.targetText: He drinks coffee every morning, but right now he is drinking milk.
drills.translation: Dia minum kopi setiap pagi, tapi saat ini dia sedang minum susu.

drills.prompt: Are you working today or are you resting?
drills.targetText: Are you working today or are you resting?
drills.translation: Apakah kamu bekerja hari ini atau sedang istirahat?

roleplay.context: Tutor bertanya tentang kebiasaan harianmu vs apa yang sedang kamu lakukan minggu ini.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What do you usually do on weekends, and what are you doing this weekend?
turns.translation: Apa yang biasanya kamu lakukan di akhir pekan, dan apa yang sedang kamu lakukan akhir pekan ini?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I usually rest at home, but this weekend I am traveling with my family.
turns.translation: Saya biasanya istirahat di rumah, tapi akhir pekan ini saya sedang bepergian bersama keluarga saya.

challenge.scenario: Bandingkan 1 hal yang biasa kamu lakukan setiap hari dengan 1 hal khusus yang sedang kamu kerjakan hari ini.
challenge.example: I usually wake up at six, but today I am waking up earlier to study.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang tepat untuk kebiasaan umum:
options: She is teaching English every Tuesday.
questions.explanation: Kebiasaan atau jadwal rutin 'every Tuesday' menggunakan Present Simple (teaches).

questions.question: Doni ______ to the gym right now.
questions.explanation: Keterangan waktu 'right now' menandakan aksi sedang berlangsung (is going).

questions.question: 'I am living in Bali for two months.' Kalimat ini bermakna:
questions.explanation: Present continuous pada kata kerja live menyatakan kondisi tempat tinggal sementara.

questions.question: Listen! Someone ______ on the front door.
questions.explanation: Perintah 'Listen!' menunjukkan peristiwa sedang terjadi saat berbicara.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang SALAH?
options: I am working here right now.
questions.explanation: Kata kerja stative 'know' umumnya tidak digunakan dalam bentuk continuous (bukan 'am knowing').

modules.title: Future with 'Be Going To': Plans & Intentions
modules.objective: Mampu menyatakan rencana masa depan yang sudah dipikirkan dan direncanakan sebelumnya menggunakan rumus 'Be Going To + Verb 1'.

content.concept: Subject + am/is/are + going to + Verb 1 (Contoh: 'I am going to visit Bali next month', 'They are going to buy a new house').
rules: Subject + am/is/are + going to + Verb 1 (Contoh: 'I am going to visit Bali next month', 'They are going to buy a new house').
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Sering mengartikan 'going to' selalu berarti pergi ke tempat fisik. Padahal 'be going to + V1' bermakna 'akan / berencana melakukan sesuatu'.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Sering mengartikan 'going to' selalu berarti pergi ke tempat fisik. Padahal 'be going to + V1' bermakna 'akan / berencana melakukan sesuatu'.

items.example: We have a solid plan for next holiday.
My intention is to improve my spoken English.
They are going to take a vacation in Lombok.
I am going to start a new job next month.
What are you going to cook tonight?
He is going to wash his car tomorrow morning.
She is going to save money for a laptop.
We are going to attend my cousin's wedding.

content.context: Arif dan Lisa mendiskusikan rencana akhir pekan mereka.

dialogue.speaker: Arif
dialogue.text: Lisa, do you have any plans for this Saturday?
dialogue.translation: Lisa, apa kamu punya rencana untuk hari Sabtu ini?

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.text: Yes, I am going to bake a cake with my sister. How about you?
dialogue.translation: Ya, aku akan membuat kue bersama saudara perempuanku. Bagaimana denganmu?

dialogue.speaker: Arif
dialogue.text: I am going to visit the new museum downtown.
dialogue.translation: Aku akan mengunjungi museum baru di pusat kota.

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! Are you going to go by car or motorcycle?
dialogue.translation: Kedengarannya menyenangkan! Apakah kamu akan pergi naik mobil atau motor?

drills.prompt: I am going to learn ten new vocabulary words today.
drills.targetText: I am going to learn ten new vocabulary words today.
drills.translation: Saya akan belajar sepuluh kosakata baru hari ini.

drills.prompt: We are going to travel to Yogyakarta next December.
drills.targetText: We are going to travel to Yogyakarta next December.
drills.translation: Kami akan bepergian ke Yogyakarta Desember depan.

drills.prompt: What are you going to do after work today?
drills.targetText: What are you going to do after work today?
drills.translation: Apa yang akan kamu lakukan setelah pulang kerja hari ini?

roleplay.context: Tutor bertanya tentang rencana liburan atau akhir pekanmu.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What are you going to do this weekend?
turns.translation: Apa yang akan kamu lakukan akhir pekan ini?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I am going to clean my room and watch a movie with my friends.
turns.translation: Saya akan membersihkan kamar saya dan menonton film bersama teman-teman saya.

challenge.scenario: Jelaskan 2 rencana pasti yang akan kamu lakukan dalam 7 hari ke depan dengan pola 'be going to'.
challenge.example: Next week, I am going to buy a new book and I am going to visit my grandmother.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat rencana yang tepat:
options: She is going to buy a ticket.
She going to buy a ticket.
She is go to buy a ticket.
She is going buy a ticket.
questions.explanation: Rumus lengkap: Subject + is/am/are + going to + V1.
questions.answer: She is going to buy a ticket.

questions.question: We ______ to visit our grandparents this weekend.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'We' menggunakan to be 'are'.

questions.question: Bentuk negatif dari 'They are going to move':
options: They are not going to move.
They do not going to move.
They will not going to move.
They not are going to move.
questions.explanation: Negasi disisipkan setelah to be: 'are not going to'.
questions.answer: They are not going to move.

questions.question: Kapan 'be going to' paling tepat digunakan?
options: Untuk rencana yang sudah diputuskan sebelumnya.
questions.explanation: 'Be going to' digunakan untuk rencana atau niatan yang sudah dibuat sebelumnya.
questions.answer: Untuk rencana yang sudah diputuskan sebelumnya.

questions.question: Lengkapi kalimat tanya: '______ you going to call him tonight?'
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan Yes/No untuk 'be going to' diawali dengan To Be (Are you going to...).

modules.title: Future with 'Will': Decisions & Predictions
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan modal 'Will / Won't' untuk membuat keputusan spontan, menawarkan bantuan, dan memprediksi masa depan.

content.concept: Subject + will + Verb 1 (Singkatan: I'll, You'll, We'll, He'll, She'll, They'll). Negasi: will not = won't.
rules: Subject + will + Verb 1 (Singkatan: I'll, You'll, We'll, He'll, She'll, They'll). Negasi: will not = won't.
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Menggunakan 'will' untuk semua hal masa depan termasuk rencana yang sudah dijadwalkan tiketnya. Gunakan 'will' saat keputusan baru saja dibuat seketika itu juga.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Menggunakan 'will' untuk semua hal masa depan termasuk rencana yang sudah dijadwalkan tiketnya. Gunakan 'will' saat keputusan baru saja dibuat seketika itu juga.

items.example: I will call you when I arrive, I promise.
It was a spontaneous decision to help him.
I think it will be sunny tomorrow.
That box looks heavy. I will carry it for you.
The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
I will decide after the meeting.
He will probably come late tonight.
Don't worry, I won't forget your birthday.

content.context: Di kantor, Maya melihat Bima membawa tumpukan dokumen tebal.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Bima, that stack of files looks really heavy!
dialogue.translation: Bima, tumpukan berkas itu terlihat sangat berat!

dialogue.speaker: Bima
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. I am bringing them to the archive room.
dialogue.translation: Ya, betul. Aku sedang membawanya ke ruang arsip.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Hold on, I will open the door for you.
dialogue.translation: Tunggu sebentar, aku akan membukakan pintunya untukmu.

dialogue.speaker: Bima
dialogue.text: Thank you so much Maya, that's very kind of you!
dialogue.translation: Terima kasih banyak Maya, kamu baik sekali!

drills.prompt: I am thirsty. I will get a glass of water.
drills.targetText: I am thirsty. I will get a glass of water.
drills.translation: Saya haus. Saya akan mengambil segelas air.

drills.prompt: Don't worry, I will help you with your homework.
drills.targetText: Don't worry, I will help you with your homework.
drills.translation: Jangan khawatir, saya akan membantumu dengan PR-mu.

drills.prompt: I think tomorrow will be a wonderful day.
drills.targetText: I think tomorrow will be a wonderful day.
drills.translation: Saya rasa besok akan menjadi hari yang menyenangkan.

roleplay.context: Tutor membutuhkan bantuan dan kamu menawarkan bantuan spontan dengan kata 'will'.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Oh no, I forgot my notebook in the other room!
turns.translation: Aduh, saya lupa buku catatan saya di ruangan sebelah!

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Don't worry, I will get it for you right now.
turns.translation: Jangan khawatir, saya akan mengambilkannya untuk Anda sekarang juga.

challenge.scenario: Bayangkan seseorang sedang membawa barang berat atau kedinginan. Buat 2 kalimat tawaran bantuan spontan menggunakan 'will'.
challenge.example: You look cold. I will close the window and I will make hot tea for you.

questions.question: Someone is knocking at the door. Respon spontan yang tepat:
questions.explanation: Keputusan spontan pada saat berbicara menggunakan 'will + V1' (I will open it).

questions.question: Bentuk singkat dari 'I will not':
questions.explanation: Bentuk kontraksi baku dari will not adalah won't.

questions.question: I promise I ______ tell anyone your secret.
questions.explanation: Konteks janji tidak membeberkan rahasia memakai 'won't' (will not).

questions.question: Kalimat manakah yang merupakan prediksi?
options: I think Manchester United will win tonight.
questions.explanation: Frasa 'I think ... will win' adalah ungkapan prediksi masa depan.
questions.answer: I think Manchester United will win tonight.

questions.question: Pilih susunan kalimat tanya will yang benar:
options: Will you come to my party?
Do you will come to my party?
Are you will come to my party?
You will come to my party?
questions.explanation: Inversi pertanyaan dengan modal will: Will + Subject + V1.
questions.answer: Will you come to my party?

modules.title: Comparatives: Comparing People, Cities & Things
modules.objective: Mampu membandingkan dua benda, orang, atau tempat menggunakan aturan kata sifat 1 suku kata (-er than) dan 2+ suku kata (more ... than).

content.concept: 1 suku kata: adjective + -er + than (faster than, taller than, cheaper than). 2+ suku kata: more + adjective + than (more expensive than, more comfortable than). Bentuk ireguler: good -> better, bad -> worse.
rules: 1 suku kata: adjective + -er + than (faster than, taller than, cheaper than). 2+ suku kata: more + adjective + than (more expensive than, more comfortable than). Bentuk ireguler: good -> better, bad -> worse.
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering menggabungkan 'more' dengan akhiran '-er' (Contoh salah: 'more faster'
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering menggabungkan 'more' dengan akhiran '-er' (Contoh salah: 'more faster' ❌). Cukup gunakan salah satu: 'faster' atau 'more expensive'.

items.example: Taking the train is cheaper than taking a taxi.
The airplane is faster than the boat.
My brother is taller than me.
This hotel is more expensive than that motel.
Jakarta is more crowded than Yogyakarta.
Your English pronunciation is much better now.
The traffic today is worse than yesterday.
This lesson is easier than the last one.

content.context: Rudi dan Fani membandingkan dua kota untuk tempat liburan.

dialogue.speaker: Rudi
dialogue.text: Fani, which city is better for vacation, Bandung or Bali?
dialogue.translation: Fani, kota mana yang lebih baik untuk liburan, Bandung atau Bali?

dialogue.speaker: Fani
dialogue.text: Bali has better beaches, but Bandung is cooler and closer.
dialogue.translation: Bali punya pantai yang lebih baik, tapi Bandung lebih sejuk dan lebih dekat.

dialogue.speaker: Rudi
dialogue.text: Is accommodation more expensive in Bali?
dialogue.translation: Apakah akomodasi lebih mahal di Bali?

dialogue.speaker: Fani
dialogue.text: Yes, hotels in Bali are generally more expensive than in Bandung.
dialogue.translation: Ya, hotel di Bali umumnya lebih mahal daripada di Bandung.

drills.prompt: A train is faster and safer than a motorcycle.
drills.targetText: A train is faster and safer than a motorcycle.
drills.translation: Kereta api lebih cepat dan lebih aman daripada sepeda motor.

drills.prompt: Living in a village is quieter than in a big city.
drills.targetText: Living in a village is quieter than in a big city.
drills.translation: Tinggal di desa lebih tenang daripada di kota besar.

drills.prompt: This new laptop is more modern than my old computer.
drills.targetText: This new laptop is more modern than my old computer.
drills.translation: Laptop baru ini lebih modern daripada komputer lama saya.

roleplay.context: Bandingkan dua handphone atau dua jenis makanan dengan bantuan tutor.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Between tea and coffee, which one do you like and why?
turns.translation: Antara teh dan kopi, mana yang lebih kamu suka dan mengapa?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I prefer coffee because it makes me feel more energetic in the morning.
turns.translation: Saya lebih memilih kopi karena itu membuat saya merasa lebih berenergi di pagi hari.

challenge.scenario: Bandingkan dua kota di Indonesia (misal Jakarta vs Yogyakarta) dalam hal harga, cuaca, atau kepadatan lalu lintas dalam 2 kalimat.
challenge.example: Jakarta is more crowded than Yogyakarta. However, food in Yogyakarta is cheaper than in Jakarta.

questions.question: Pilih perbandingan yang benar untuk kata 'fast':
questions.explanation: Kata sifat 1 suku kata ditambah akhiran '-er' (faster).

questions.question: Kalimat yang BENAR tata bahasanya:
options: Gold is more expensive than silver.
Gold is more expensiver than silver.
Gold is as expensive than silver.
questions.explanation: 'Expensive' terdiri dari 3 suku kata, sehingga menggunakan 'more expensive than'.
questions.answer: Gold is more expensive than silver.

questions.question: Bentuk comparative dari kata 'good' adalah:
questions.explanation: 'Good' adalah kata sifat ireguler; bentuk perbandingannya adalah 'better'.

questions.question: This math test was ______ than the English test.
questions.explanation: Kata berakhiran huruf -y seperti 'easy' berubah menjadi '-ier' (easier).

questions.question: Apa arti dari 'My score is worse than his score'?
options: Skor saya lebih bagus dari dia.
Skor saya lebih buruk dari skor dia.
questions.explanation: 'Worse' adalah bentuk perbandingan dari 'bad' yang berarti lebih buruk.
questions.answer: Skor saya lebih buruk dari skor dia.

modules.title: Superlatives: The Best, Worst & Most
modules.objective: Mampu menyatakan tingkatan tertinggi (paling / ter-) menggunakan pola superlatif 'the -est' dan 'the most'.

content.concept: 1 suku kata: the + adjective + -est (the fastest, the cheapest, the tallest). 2+ suku kata: the most + adjective (the most beautiful, the most expensive). Ireguler: the best, the worst.
rules: 1 suku kata: the + adjective + -est (the fastest, the cheapest, the tallest). 2+ suku kata: the most + adjective (the most beautiful, the most expensive). Ireguler: the best, the worst.
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Sering lupa menyertakan artikel 'the'. Di bahasa Inggris, bentuk superlatif WAJIB diawali kata 'the' (Contoh: 'He is the tallest', bukan 'He is tallest'
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Sering lupa menyertakan artikel 'the'. Di bahasa Inggris, bentuk superlatif WAJIB diawali kata 'the' (Contoh: 'He is the tallest', bukan 'He is tallest' ❌).

items.example: This is the best restaurant in town.
That was the worst movie I have ever seen.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
This diamond ring is the most expensive item.
Cheetahs are the fastest land animals.
This building is the oldest museum in the country.
Today is the happiest day of my life.
Fried rice is the most popular dish in Indonesia.

content.context: Dua rekan kerja mendiskusikan destinasi kuliner terbaik di kota.

dialogue.speaker: Anita
dialogue.text: Budi, where can we get the best coffee around here?
dialogue.translation: Budi, di mana kita bisa dapat kopi terbaik di sekitar sini?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: Corner Cafe has the best espresso, and it is also the cleanest place.
dialogue.translation: Corner Cafe punya espresso terbaik, dan tempatnya juga paling bersih.

dialogue.speaker: Anita
dialogue.text: Is it the most expensive cafe?
dialogue.translation: Apakah itu kafe yang paling mahal?

dialogue.speaker: Budi
dialogue.text: No, their prices are reasonable. Grand Lounge is the most expensive one.
dialogue.translation: Tidak, harganya wajar. Grand Lounge lah yang paling mahal.

drills.prompt: Indonesian cuisine is one of the most delicious in the world.
drills.targetText: Indonesian cuisine is one of the most delicious in the world.
drills.translation: Masakan Indonesia adalah salah satu yang paling lezat di dunia.

drills.prompt: He is the smartest student in our classroom.
drills.targetText: He is the smartest student in our classroom.
drills.translation: Dia adalah murid paling pintar di kelas kami.

drills.prompt: What is the longest river in Southeast Asia?
drills.targetText: What is the longest river in Southeast Asia?
drills.translation: Apa sungai terpanjang di Asia Tenggara?

roleplay.context: Tutor bertanya tentang pengalaman terbaik atau tempat terbaik yang pernah kamu kunjungi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What is the most beautiful place you have ever visited?
turns.translation: Tempat apa yang paling indah yang pernah kamu kunjungi?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: The most beautiful place I have visited is Labuan Bajo because of its sunsets.
turns.translation: Tempat paling indah yang pernah saya kunjungi adalah Labuan Bajo karena pemandangan matahari terbenamnya.

challenge.scenario: Sebutkan 1 hal yang paling kamu sukai di kotamu (makanan, tempat, atau orang) dengan pola superlatif.
challenge.example: In my opinion, rendang is the most delicious dish and Borobudur is the most amazing temple.

questions.question: Pilih bentuk superlatif yang tepat untuk 'small':
questions.explanation: Kata sifat 1 suku kata superlatif memakai 'the -est' (the smallest).

questions.question: Which car is ______ in the world?
questions.explanation: Superlatif wajib menggunakan artikel 'the' (the fastest).

questions.question: Bentuk superlatif dari 'good' adalah:
questions.explanation: 'Good' bentuk superlatif iregulernya adalah 'the best'.

questions.question: This is ______ difficult question on the exam.
questions.explanation: 'Difficult' bersuku kata 3, sehingga bentuknya 'the most difficult'.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang BENAR?
options: She is the most prettiest girl.
questions.explanation: Kata berakhiran -y memakai '-iest' dengan 'the' tanpa tambahan kata 'most' (the prettiest).

modules.title: Modals of Advice: Should & Shouldn't
modules.objective: Mampu memberikan dan meminta saran atau rekomendasi secara sopan menggunakan modal 'should' dan 'shouldn't'.

content.concept: Subject + should / shouldn't + Verb 1 murni (Contoh: 'You should drink more water', 'You shouldn't stay up late'). Jangan tambahkan 'to' setelah should!
rules: Subject + should / shouldn't + Verb 1 murni (Contoh: 'You should drink more water', 'You shouldn't stay up late'). Jangan tambahkan 'to' setelah should!
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering keliru menambahkan 'to' setelah modal: 'You should to sleep'
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering keliru menambahkan 'to' setelah modal: 'You should to sleep' ❌ -> Benar: 'You should sleep' ✅.

items.example: Can you give me some good advice?
I strongly recommend this book.
You look tired, you should rest now.
If you have a headache, you should take medicine.
We should eat healthy vegetables every day.
You shouldn't skip breakfast in the morning.
Everyone should exercise at least three times a week.
You have a toothache, you should see a dentist.

content.context: Rian mengeluh kurang enak badan kepada temannya, Nadia.

dialogue.speaker: Rian
dialogue.text: Nadia, I have a terrible headache and I feel exhausted.
dialogue.translation: Nadia, aku sakit kepala parah dan merasa sangat lelah.

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: You should turn off your computer screen and take a short nap.
dialogue.translation: Kamu sebaiknya mematikan layar komputermu dan tidur siang sebentar.

dialogue.speaker: Rian
dialogue.text: Should I drink some warm tea too?
dialogue.translation: Apakah aku sebaiknya minum teh hangat juga?

dialogue.speaker: Nadia
dialogue.text: Yes, and you shouldn't drink any more cold soda today.
dialogue.translation: Ya, dan kamu sebaiknya tidak minum soda dingin lagi hari ini.

drills.prompt: You should drink eight glasses of water every day.
drills.targetText: You should drink eight glasses of water every day.
drills.translation: Kamu sebaiknya minum delapan gelas air setiap hari.

drills.prompt: We shouldn't arrive late for the presentation.
drills.targetText: We shouldn't arrive late for the presentation.
drills.translation: Kita sebaiknya tidak datang terlambat untuk presentasi.

drills.prompt: What should I do to speak English fluently?
drills.targetText: What should I do to speak English fluently?
drills.translation: Apa yang sebaiknya saya lakukan agar lancar berbicara bahasa Inggris?

roleplay.context: Tutor mengeluh sering lupa kosakata baru. Berikan saran menggunakan 'should'.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I often forget new English words quickly. What should I do?
turns.translation: Saya sering cepat lupa kosakata bahasa Inggris baru. Apa yang sebaiknya saya lakukan?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: You should practice speaking them every day and write them in a small notebook.
turns.translation: Anda sebaiknya mempraktikkan pengucapannya setiap hari dan menuliskannya di buku catatan kecil.

challenge.scenario: Berikan 2 saran kesehatan bagi teman yang sering bekerja lembur dan kurang tidur.
challenge.example: You should sleep for seven hours every night and you shouldn't drink coffee late in the evening.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat memberi saran yang benar:
options: You should to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: Modal 'should' selalu diikuti Verb 1 murni tanpa 'to' (should see).

questions.question: Kalimat larangan sopan: 'You ______ drive when you feel sleepy.'
questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't' (sebaiknya tidak) digunakan untuk menasihati agar tidak menyetir saat mengantuk.

questions.question: Susunan kalimat tanya meminta saran yang tepat:
questions.explanation: Inversi pertanyaan modal: WH + should + Subject + V1.

questions.question: Apa makna dari 'You should eat more fruit'?
options: Kamu disarankan makan lebih banyak buah.
questions.explanation: 'Should' menyatakan saran atau rekomendasi yang baik untuk dilakukan.
questions.answer: Kamu disarankan makan lebih banyak buah.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang SALAH?
questions.explanation: Penggunaan 'should to study' salah karena modal tidak boleh diikuti 'to'.

modules.title: Modals of Obligation: Must vs Have to vs Don't Have to
modules.objective: Mampu membedakan keharusan aturan (must/have to), larangan keras (must not), dan ketiadaan keharusan (don't have to).

content.concept: Must / Have to = harus/wajib. Must not (mustn't) = DILARANG. Don't have to = TIDAK HARUS / TIDAK PERLU (boleh dilakukan, boleh tidak).
rules: Must / Have to = harus/wajib. Must not (mustn't) = DILARANG. Don't have to = TIDAK HARUS / TIDAK PERLU (boleh dilakukan, boleh tidak).
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering salah mengartikan 'don't have to' sebagai 'dilarang'. Ingat: 'Don't have to' artinya 'tidak perlu / tidak wajib'. Larangan adalah 'must not'.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering salah mengartikan 'don't have to' sebagai 'dilarang'. Ingat: 'Don't have to' artinya 'tidak perlu / tidak wajib'. Larangan adalah 'must not'.

items.example: Wearing a helmet is a legal obligation.
You must stop when the traffic light is red.
I have to wake up early for work.
You mustn't smoke in the hospital.
Tomorrow is Sunday, you don't have to work.
Riders must wear a standard helmet.
You must show your passport at airport security.
We must follow the safety rules.

content.context: Di kantor imigrasi atau bandara internasional.

dialogue.speaker: Petugas
dialogue.text: Good morning. You must show your passport and boarding pass.
dialogue.translation: Selamat pagi. Anda harus menunjukkan paspor dan tiket boarding pass Anda.

dialogue.speaker: Wisatawan
dialogue.text: Here they are. Do I have to take off my shoes?
dialogue.translation: Ini dia. Apakah saya harus melepas sepatu saya?

dialogue.speaker: Petugas
dialogue.text: No, you don't have to take them off. But you mustn't carry any liquids over 100ml.
dialogue.translation: Tidak, Anda tidak perlu melepasnya. Tapi Anda dilarang membawa cairan di atas 100ml.

dialogue.speaker: Wisatawan
dialogue.text: Understood, thank you officer.
dialogue.translation: Dimengerti, terima kasih petugas.

drills.prompt: You must wear a seatbelt when driving a car.
drills.targetText: You must wear a seatbelt when driving a car.
drills.translation: Kamu harus mengenakan sabuk pengaman saat menyetir mobil.

drills.prompt: You mustn't touch that wire, it is dangerous.
drills.targetText: You mustn't touch that wire, it is dangerous.
drills.translation: Kamu dilarang menyentuh kabel itu, itu berbahaya.

drills.prompt: Today is a holiday, so we don't have to wear uniforms.
drills.targetText: Today is a holiday, so we don't have to wear uniforms.
drills.translation: Hari ini hari libur, jadi kita tidak perlu mengenakan seragam.

roleplay.context: Diskusikan peraturan di tempat kerja atau sekolah bersama tutor.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What are the most important rules in your office or school?
turns.translation: Apa peraturan terpenting di kantor atau sekolahmu?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We must arrive before eight o'clock, and we mustn't be noisy in the meeting room.
turns.translation: Kami harus tiba sebelum jam delapan, dan kami dilarang berisik di ruang rapat.

challenge.scenario: Sebutkan 1 hal yang wajib (must) dan 1 hal yang dilarang (must not) di tempat umum seperti perpustakaan atau pesawat.
challenge.example: In the library, you must keep quiet and you mustn't eat smelly food.

questions.question: The museum is free on Fridays. You ______ pay admission.
questions.explanation: Karena gratis, kamu 'tidak perlu / tidak harus' bayar (don't have to).

questions.question: This is a non-smoking area. You ______ smoke here.
questions.explanation: Tanda larangan keras menggunakan 'mustn't' (must not).

questions.question: All passengers ______ wear seatbelts during takeoff.
questions.explanation: Kewajiban keselamatan mutlak menggunakan 'must'.

questions.question: She ______ work on Saturdays because her office is closed.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' menggunakan bentuk negatif 'doesn't have to'.

questions.question: Apa beda 'mustn't' dan 'don't have to'?
options: Mustn't = dilarang, Don't have to = tidak wajib/tidak perlu.
Mustn't = boleh, Don't have to = dilarang keras.
Don't have to adalah bentuk lampau.
questions.explanation: Mustn't berarti larangan mutlak, sedangkan don't have to berarti tidak ada keharusan.
questions.answer: Mustn't = dilarang, Don't have to = tidak wajib/tidak perlu.

modules.title: Essential Phrasal Verbs 1: Daily Life
modules.objective: Mampu memahami dan menggunakan phrasal verb harian yang paling sering dipakai (wake up, get up, put on, take off, turn on/off, look for).

content.concept: Phrasal verb adalah gabungan Verb + Preposisi/Partikel yang memiliki arti khusus berbeda dari arti kata dasar. Contoh: turn (putar) + on (nyala) = turn on (menyalakan).
rules: Phrasal verb adalah gabungan Verb + Preposisi/Partikel yang memiliki arti khusus berbeda dari arti kata dasar. Contoh: turn (putar) + on (nyala) = turn on (menyalakan).
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Menerjemahkan kata demi kata: 'turn on' diterjemahkan 'putar di atas'
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Menerjemahkan kata demi kata: 'turn on' diterjemahkan 'putar di atas' ❌. Pahami phrasal verb sebagai satu kesatuan kosakata utuh.

items.example: I usually wake up at 5:30 in the morning.
I wake up at six, but I get up at 6:15.
Please turn on the air conditioner, it is hot.
Remember to turn off the lights before you leave.
Put on your jacket, it is chilly outside.
Please take off your shoes before entering.
I am looking for my car keys.
Never give up on learning English!

content.context: Di rumah sebelum berangkat bekerja di pagi hari.

dialogue.speaker: Ibu
dialogue.text: Dimas, please get up! You have a morning meeting.
dialogue.translation: Dimas, ayo bangun! Kamu ada rapat pagi.

dialogue.speaker: Dimas
dialogue.text: I am already awake, Mom. I am looking for my tie.
dialogue.translation: Aku sudah bangun kok, Bu. Aku sedang mencari dasiku.

dialogue.speaker: Ibu
dialogue.text: It is on the chair. Put on your shoes and don't forget to turn off your bedroom fan.
dialogue.translation: Ada di atas kursi. Pakai sepatumu dan jangan lupa matikan kipas kamarmu.

dialogue.speaker: Dimas
dialogue.text: Got it, Mom. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Siap, Bu. Terima kasih!

drills.prompt: Could you please turn on the lamp? It is dark here.
drills.targetText: Could you please turn on the lamp? It is dark here.
drills.translation: Bisakah kamu menyalakan lampunya? Di sini gelap.

drills.prompt: I am looking for my wallet everywhere.
drills.targetText: I am looking for my wallet everywhere.
drills.translation: Saya sedang mencari dompet saya di mana-mana.

drills.prompt: He took off his coat and sat down on the sofa.
drills.targetText: He took off his coat and sat down on the sofa.
drills.translation: Dia melepas jasnya dan duduk di atas sofa.

roleplay.context: Kamu kehilangan kunci atau kacamata dan meminta bantuan teman.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Why are you searching under the table? Are you looking for something?
turns.translation: Kenapa kamu mencari di bawah meja? Apakah kamu sedang mencari sesuatu?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I am looking for my house keys. I dropped them a minute ago.
turns.translation: Ya, saya sedang mencari kunci rumah saya. Saya menjatuhkannya semenit yang lalu.

challenge.scenario: Ceritakan urutan rutinitas pagimu memakai minimal 3 phrasal verb (misal: wake up, turn on, put on).
challenge.example: Every morning, I wake up at six. I turn on the kitchen radio, and I put on my running shoes.

questions.question: It is very cold outside. You should ______ your coat.
questions.explanation: 'Put on' berarti memakai (pakaian/jaket).

questions.question: Before going to sleep, you must ______ the TV.
questions.explanation: 'Turn off' bermakna mematikan perangkat elektronik.

questions.question: Excuse me, I am ______ the nearest train station.
questions.explanation: 'Looking for' berarti mencari arah atau barang.

questions.question: Lawan kata dari 'put on' (memakai) adalah:
questions.explanation: Lawan kata 'put on' pakaian adalah 'take off' (melepas).

questions.question: Apa beda 'wake up' dan 'get up'?
options: Wake up = sadar dari tidur, Get up = bangkit beranjak dari kasur.
Get up = tidur lagi, Wake up = mandi.
Wake up hanya dipakai malam hari.
questions.explanation: Wake up adalah membuka mata/terjaga, sedangkan get up adalah bangkit berdiri dari ranjang.
questions.answer: Wake up = sadar dari tidur, Get up = bangkit beranjak dari kasur.

modules.title: Conjunctions: Because, So, But, Although
modules.objective: Mampu menggabungkan dua ide menjadi kalimat majemuk logis menggunakan kata penghubung sebab-akibat dan kontras.

content.concept: Because = karena (alasan). So = jadi / sehingga (akibat). But = tetapi (kontras sederhana). Although = meskipun / walaupun (kontras mendalam).
rules: Because = karena (alasan). So = jadi / sehingga (akibat). But = tetapi (kontras sederhana). Although = meskipun / walaupun (kontras mendalam).
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering menggabungkan 'Because' dan 'So' dalam satu kalimat (Contoh salah: 'Because I was tired, so I slept'
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering menggabungkan 'Because' dan 'So' dalam satu kalimat (Contoh salah: 'Because I was tired, so I slept' ❌). Gunakan salah satu: 'Because I was tired, I slept' ATAU 'I was tired, so I slept' ✅.

items.example: I stayed home because it was raining.
I was hungry, so I cooked noodles.
He studied hard, but he failed the test.
Although it was cold, we enjoyed the swim.
The car is old. However, it still runs well.
What is the reason for your absence?
His score was the result of consistent practice.
Conjunctions connect two clauses together.

content.context: Dua sahabat membicarakan alasan tidak hadir di acara reuni.

dialogue.speaker: Tari
dialogue.text: Dimas, why didn't you come to the reunion last night?
dialogue.translation: Dimas, kenapa kamu tidak datang ke reuni semalam?

dialogue.speaker: Dimas
dialogue.text: I wanted to come, but I had to finish urgent office work.
dialogue.translation: Aku ingin datang, tetapi aku harus menyelesaikan pekerjaan kantor yang mendesak.

dialogue.speaker: Tari
dialogue.text: Oh, that's too bad. We missed you!
dialogue.translation: Oh, sayang sekali. Kami merindukanmu!

dialogue.speaker: Dimas
dialogue.text: I finished late, so I decided to sleep immediately.
dialogue.translation: Aku selesai larut, sehingga aku memutuskan untuk langsung tidur.

drills.prompt: I study English every day because I want to study abroad.
drills.targetText: I study English every day because I want to study abroad.
drills.translation: Saya belajar bahasa Inggris setiap hari karena saya ingin kuliah di luar negeri.

drills.prompt: She woke up late, so she missed the morning bus.
drills.targetText: She woke up late, so she missed the morning bus.
drills.translation: Dia bangun kesiangan, sehingga dia ketinggalan bus pagi.

drills.prompt: Although he was very tired, he finished the report on time.
drills.targetText: Although he was very tired, he finished the report on time.
drills.translation: Meskipun dia sangat lelah, dia menyelesaikan laporannya tepat waktu.

roleplay.context: Jelaskan alasan mengapa kamu menyukai kopi atau teh dengan kata penghubung.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Why do you like learning English online?
turns.translation: Mengapa kamu suka belajar bahasa Inggris secara online?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I like learning online because it is flexible, but I must stay disciplined.
turns.translation: Saya suka belajar online karena fleksibel, tetapi saya harus tetap disiplin.

challenge.scenario: Buat 1 kalimat sebab-akibat (menggunakan 'because' atau 'so') dan 1 kalimat kontras (menggunakan 'but' atau 'although').
challenge.example: I exercised today because I want to stay fit. Although it was raining, I still went for a walk.

questions.question: I didn't have breakfast, ______ I am very hungry now.
questions.explanation: 'So' digunakan untuk menghubungkan sebab ke akibat/hasil.

questions.question: She bought the dress ______ it was quite expensive.
questions.explanation: 'Although' (meskipun) digunakan untuk menunjukkan kontras yang mengejutkan.

questions.question: Manakah kalimat yang BENAR tanpa redundansi bahasa Indonesia?
options: Because it rained, so we cancelled the match.
Because it rained, we cancelled the match.
Although it rained, but we played.
Because why it rained, so we stayed.
questions.explanation: Jangan gunakan 'because' bersamaan dengan 'so' dalam satu kalimat.
questions.answer: Because it rained, we cancelled the match.

questions.question: He wants to buy a motorcycle, ______ he doesn't have enough money yet.
questions.explanation: 'But' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua ide yang bertolak belakang.

questions.question: Lengkapi: 'We stayed at home ______ the storm was severe.'
questions.explanation: 'Because' menjelaskan alasan mengapa mereka tinggal di rumah.

modules.title: Restaurant & Social Logistics: Ordering, Requests & The Bill
modules.objective: Mampu memesan makanan, menanyakan rekomendasi menu, meminta tagihan (bill), dan menyelesaikan urusan di restoran dengan sopan.

content.concept: Pola sopan pemesanan: 'I would like to have...', 'Could I get...', 'Could we have the bill, please?'. Jangan gunakan 'I want' yang terkesan kasar.
rules: Pola sopan pemesanan: 'I would like to have...', 'Could I get...', 'Could we have the bill, please?'. Jangan gunakan 'I want' yang terkesan kasar.
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Orang Indonesia sering bilang 'I want chicken' yang terdengar menuntut. Gunakan 'I would like...' atau 'Could I have...' untuk kesopanan standar internasional.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Orang Indonesia sering bilang 'I want chicken' yang terdengar menuntut. Gunakan 'I would like...' atau 'Could I have...' untuk kesopanan standar internasional.

items.example: Could we see the dessert menu, please?
Are you ready to order, sir?
We will start with soup as our appetizer.
For my main course, I would like grilled chicken.
Could we have the bill, please?
Chocolate cake is my favorite dessert.
What is the chef's recommendation today?
The pasta was absolutely delicious.

content.context: Di sebuah restoran internasional antara Pelayan (Waiter) dan Tamu (Guest).

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Good evening! Welcome to Bistro 9. Are you ready to order?
dialogue.translation: Selamat malam! Selamat datang di Bistro 9. Apakah Anda sudah siap memesan?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Yes, please. What is your special recommendation for tonight?
dialogue.translation: Ya. Apa rekomendasi spesial Anda untuk malam ini?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Our grilled salmon with lemon sauce is very fresh and popular.
dialogue.translation: Ikan salmon panggang kami dengan saus lemon sangat segar dan populer.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: That sounds wonderful. I would like the grilled salmon and a glass of iced lemon tea.
dialogue.translation: Kedengarannya luar biasa. Saya pesan salmon panggang dan segelas es teh lemon.

drills.prompt: Could I have a glass of still water, please?
drills.targetText: Could I have a glass of still water, please?
drills.translation: Bisakah saya meminta segelas air mineral biasa?

drills.prompt: Excuse me, could we have the bill please?
drills.targetText: Excuse me, could we have the bill please?
drills.translation: Permisi, bisakah kami meminta tagihannya?

drills.prompt: I would like to pay by credit card.
drills.targetText: I would like to pay by credit card.
drills.translation: Saya ingin membayar dengan kartu kredit.

roleplay.context: Simulasikan pemesanan makanan dan pembayaran tagihan dengan tutor sebagai pelayan restoran.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul (Waiter)
turns.text: Good evening, sir. Can I get you something to drink first?
turns.translation: Selamat malam. Bisakah saya bawakan minuman terlebih dahulu?

turns.speaker: You (Guest)
turns.text: Yes, could I have an iced tea, and could I also see the dinner menu?
turns.translation: Ya, bisakah saya pesan es teh, dan bisakah saya melihat menu makan malamnya?

challenge.scenario: Pesanlah 1 hidangan utama dan 1 minuman, lalu mintalah nota tagihan dengan sopan dalam bahasa Inggris.
challenge.example: I would like grilled fish and an orange juice, please. Later, could we get the check?

questions.question: Cara paling sopan memesan makanan di kafe:
options: Could I have a cappuccino, please?
questions.explanation: 'Could I have ... please?' adalah bentuk kesopanan universal di restoran.
questions.answer: Could I have a cappuccino, please?

questions.question: Bagaimana cara meminta nota tagihan pembayaran?
options: Could we have the bill, please?
questions.explanation: 'Could we have the bill, please?' adalah frasa baku meminta struk pembayaran.
questions.answer: Could we have the bill, please?

questions.question: Pelayan bertanya: 'Are you ready to order?' Jawaban yang tepat jika belum siap:
options: Could we have a few more minutes, please?
questions.explanation: 'Could we have a few more minutes, please?' meminta waktu tambahan untuk memilih menu.
questions.answer: Could we have a few more minutes, please?

questions.question: Arti dari 'main course':
questions.explanation: Main course adalah hidangan utama dalam rangkaian jamuan makan.

questions.question: Ungkapan untuk menanyakan apakah bisa bayar kartu:
questions.explanation: 'Do you accept credit cards?' adalah frasa lazim menanyakan metode pembayaran kartu.

modules.title: Full Simulation: Planning a Vacation with a Friend
modules.objective: Mampu memadukan tenses (Present Simple, Continuous, Future Going to/Will), perbandingan, dan ungkapan sopan dalam diskusi merencanakan liburan.

content.concept: Integrasi menyeluruh seluruh domain A1: menyatakan preferensi, membandingkan opsi (comparative), membuat rencana (going to), dan mengambil keputusan (will).
rules: Integrasi menyeluruh seluruh domain A1: menyatakan preferensi, membandingkan opsi (comparative), membuat rencana (going to), dan mengambil keputusan (will).
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Gugup menggabungkan tenses berbeda dalam satu percakapan. Tetap tenang: gunakan simple present untuk fakta, going to untuk rencana, dan will untuk keputusan mendadak.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Gugup menggabungkan tenses berbeda dalam satu percakapan. Tetap tenang: gunakan simple present untuk fakta, going to untuk rencana, dan will untuk keputusan mendadak.

items.example: Labuan Bajo is our dream destination.
Let's prepare the travel itinerary together.
We have a limited budget for flights.
The morning flight is cheaper than the afternoon one.
The mountain scenery was breathtaking.
I will book the hotel room tonight.
Don't forget to pack comfortable shoes.
It will be a memorable trip for all of us.

content.context: Raka dan Maya merencanakan liburan panjang akhir tahun.

dialogue.speaker: Raka
dialogue.text: Maya, where are we going to go for our December vacation?
dialogue.translation: Maya, ke mana kita akan pergi untuk liburan bulan Desember kita?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: I think Yogyakarta is better than Bandung because it has more cultural heritage.
dialogue.translation: Menurutku Yogyakarta lebih baik daripada Bandung karena punya lebih banyak warisan budaya.

dialogue.speaker: Raka
dialogue.text: I agree! And the food there is cheaper too. How are we going to travel?
dialogue.translation: Aku setuju! Dan makanan di sana juga lebih murah. Bagaimana kita akan bepergian?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: The train is more comfortable than the bus. I will check the train ticket prices online right now.
dialogue.translation: Kereta api lebih nyaman daripada bus. Aku akan cek harga tiket kereta online sekarang juga.

drills.prompt: We are going to stay at a hotel near the beach for four days.
drills.targetText: We are going to stay at a hotel near the beach for four days.
drills.translation: Kami akan menginap di hotel dekat pantai selama empat hari.

drills.prompt: I think taking the train will be more relaxing than driving.
drills.targetText: I think taking the train will be more relaxing than driving.
drills.translation: Saya rasa naik kereta akan lebih santai daripada menyetir.

drills.prompt: Don't worry about the tickets, I will book them tonight.
drills.targetText: Don't worry about the tickets, I will book them tonight.
drills.translation: Jangan khawatir soal tiketnya, saya akan memesannya malam ini.

roleplay.context: Diskusikan rencana liburan impianmu bersama tutor: tentukan kota tujuan, akomodasi, dan transportasi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! If we could take a vacation together next month, where should we go?
turns.translation: Halo! Jika kita bisa liburan bersama bulan depan, ke mana sebaiknya kita pergi?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We should go to Malang because the weather is cooler and there are many beautiful apple orchards.
turns.translation: Kita sebaiknya pergi ke Malang karena udaranya lebih sejuk dan ada banyak kebun apel yang indah.

challenge.scenario: Rencanakan liburan 3 hari: sebutkan tujuanmu, mengapa tempat itu lebih baik dari tempat lain, dan apa yang akan kamu lakukan di sana.
challenge.example: Next holiday, I am going to visit Bali because the beaches are cleaner. I will try surfing and enjoy the seafood.

questions.question: Pilih kalimat yang menggabungkan perbandingan dan rencana secara tepat:
options: Bali is nicer than Bogor, so we are going to go there.
Bali is more nice than Bogor, so we will going there.
Bali is nice than Bogor, because we go.
questions.explanation: 'Nicer than' (comparative) digabung dengan 'are going to go' (rencana).
questions.answer: Bali is nicer than Bogor, so we are going to go there.

questions.question: Maya: 'The tickets are available now!' Raka merespon spontan:
options: I will book them right away!
questions.explanation: Keputusan spontan menanggapi kabar tiket langsung menggunakan 'will + V1'.
questions.answer: I will book them right away!

questions.question: Kata yang berarti jadwal rencana perjalanan harian adalah:
questions.explanation: Itinerary adalah jadwal rencana detail kegiatan perjalanan.

questions.question: Traveling by plane is ______ than traveling by bus.
questions.explanation: Kata sifat 1 suku kata 'fast' menjadi 'faster than'.

questions.question: Di mana kita menggunakan 'I think it will rain tomorrow'?
options: Menyatakan kepastian mutlak di masa lalu.
questions.explanation: 'I think it will...' adalah ungkapan baku menyampaikan prediksi.

modules.title: Level A1.3 Comprehensive Graduation Assessment
modules.objective: Ujian komprehensif penentu kelulusan seluruh rumpun Level A1 (A1.1, A1.2, dan A1.3) mencakup tata bahasa, kelancaran bicara, dan pemahaman percakapan.

content.concept: Ujian penentu kelulusan Level A1. Syarat kelulusan minimal skor 75% untuk membuka tingkatan Level A2.
rules: Ujian penentu kelulusan Level A1. Syarat kelulusan minimal skor 75% untuk membuka tingkatan Level A2.
Gunakan bentuk kata kerja yang tepat sesuai subjek dan konteks waktu.
Perhatikan pelafalan dan penekanan intonasi kalimat.

commonMistakes.wrong: Kerjakan dengan teliti. Hindari jebakan To Be yang tertinggal, perhatikan aturan suku kata comparative/superlative, dan bedakan will dengan going to.
commonMistakes.right: Bentuk tata bahasa baku bahasa Inggris
commonMistakes.note: Kerjakan dengan teliti. Hindari jebakan To Be yang tertinggal, perhatikan aturan suku kata comparative/superlative, dan bedakan will dengan going to.

items.example: Congratulations on your level graduation!
You have demonstrated good language mastery.
This assessment evaluates your overall English skills.
You will earn a certificate upon passing.
Your speaking progress has been remarkable.
Practice is the key to speaking fluency.

content.context: Wawancara evaluasi kelulusan akhir Level A1 bersama AI Examiner.

dialogue.speaker: Examiner
dialogue.text: Welcome to your Level A1 Graduation Assessment! How do you feel today?
dialogue.translation: Selamat datang di Ujian Kelulusan Level A1! Bagaimana perasaanmu hari ini?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.text: I feel confident and excited to show what I have learned.
dialogue.translation: Saya merasa percaya diri dan bersemangat untuk menunjukkan apa yang telah saya pelajari.

dialogue.speaker: Examiner
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Let's demonstrate your mastery across all grammar and speaking topics.
dialogue.translation: Luar biasa. Mari tunjukkan penguasaanmu di seluruh topik tata bahasa dan percakapan.

drills.prompt: I am confident because I have practiced every day.
drills.targetText: I am confident because I have practiced every day.
drills.translation: Saya percaya diri karena saya telah berlatih setiap hari.

roleplay.context: Ujian akhir berbicara kelulusan bersama Mr. Khoirul.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Tell me about your routine, what you did yesterday, and what you are going to do tomorrow.
turns.translation: Ceritakan tentang rutinitasmu, apa yang kamu lakukan kemarin, dan apa yang akan kamu lakukan besok.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I work every day. Yesterday I studied grammar, and tomorrow I am going to celebrate my graduation.
turns.translation: Saya bekerja setiap hari. Kemarin saya belajar tata bahasa, dan besok saya akan merayakan kelulusan saya.

challenge.scenario: Pidato kelulusan singkat: ceritakan kemajuan bicaramu dari awal sampai hari ini dalam 3 kalimat lengkap bahasa Inggris.
challenge.example: When I started, I was nervous to speak English. Now, I can talk about my habits, past events, and future plans. I am ready for Level A2!

questions.question: Look! The cat ______ on the roof right now.
questions.explanation: Present continuous membutuhkan to be 'is' + verb-ing untuk subjek tunggal.

questions.question: She ______ to work every day, but today she is working from home.
questions.explanation: Rutinitas harian 'every day' menggunakan Present Simple (drives).

questions.question: We have bought our plane tickets. We ______ visit Bali next week.
questions.explanation: Rencana yang sudah dibeli tiketnya menggunakan 'be going to'.

questions.question: A: 'The doorbell is ringing.' B: 'I ______ get it!'
questions.explanation: Keputusan spontan seketika menggunakan 'will'.

questions.question: Tokyo is ______ than Yogyakarta.
questions.explanation: Kata sifat 'crowded' menggunakan 'more crowded than' untuk komparatif.

questions.question: Borobudur is one of ______ temples in the world.
questions.explanation: Superlatif kata sifat panjang menggunakan 'the most + adj'.

questions.question: You have a fever. You ______ consult a doctor.
questions.explanation: Saran sopan menggunakan modal 'should + V1'.

questions.question: You ______ talk during the final exam. It is strictly forbidden.
questions.explanation: Larangan mutlak menggunakan 'mustn't' (must not).

questions.question: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I ______ wake up early.
questions.explanation: Tidak ada kewajiban karena hari libur menggunakan 'don't have to'.

questions.question: Please ______ your shoes before walking on the carpet.
questions.explanation: 'Take off' berarti melepas pakaian/sepatu.

questions.question: I am ______ my glasses. Have you seen them?
questions.explanation: 'Looking for' berarti mencari barang yang hilang.

questions.question: I stayed up late last night, ______ I feel sleepy today.
questions.explanation: 'So' menunjukkan hubungan akibat/konsekuensi logis.

questions.question: Could we have ______ please? We want to pay now.
questions.explanation: 'The bill' adalah nota pembayaran di restoran.

questions.question: Bentuk comparative dari 'bad' adalah:
questions.explanation: Bentuk komparatif ireguler dari 'bad' adalah 'worse'.

questions.question: Bentuk superlatif dari 'good' adalah:
questions.explanation: Bentuk superlatif ireguler dari 'good' adalah 'the best'.
